Workflows.title: Search, Filter, and Download High-Res Photo
Workflows.goal: Search for a specific topic, apply filters, and successfully trigger a free photo download with attribution.
Workflows.starting_hint:
1. Navigate to https://unsplash.com
2. Type 'nature' into the main search bar and press Enter.
3. Click the 'Filters' button or the 'Orientation' dropdown and select 'Landscape'.
4. Click on any photo thumbnail in the results grid to open the detail view.
5. Click the 'Download free' button in the top right corner of the modal.
6. Verify that the 'Say thanks' attribution pop-up appears.

Workflows.title: Topic-Based Content Discovery
Workflows.goal: Navigate to a specific photography topic and verify relevant content is displayed.
Workflows.starting_hint:
1. Navigate to https://unsplash.com
2. Locate the topic navigation bar below the main header.
3. Click on the 'Architecture' topic link.
4. Verify that the page title and the image grid update to show architectural photography.

Workflows.title: API Documentation and Endpoint Reference
Workflows.goal: Navigate the developer portal to find specific API endpoint documentation and request parameters.
Workflows.starting_hint:
1. Navigate to https://unsplash.com/developers
2. Click the 'Documentation' link in the top navigation.
3. In the sidebar, click on 'Search photos' under the 'Actions' or 'Endpoints' section.
4. Verify that the 'Search photos' documentation loads, showing the GET /search/photos endpoint and its parameters (query, page, etc.).

Workflows.title: System Status Monitoring
Workflows.goal: Check the real-time operational status of the Unsplash API and services.
Workflows.starting_hint:
1. Navigate to https://unsplash.com/developers
2. Click the 'API Status' link in the navigation bar.
3. Verify that you are redirected to https://status.unsplash.com/ and that the 'All Systems Operational' message is visible.

Workflows.title: Unsplash Lite Dataset Download
Workflows.goal: Access and download the open-source Lite dataset for research or development.
Workflows.starting_hint:
1. Navigate to https://unsplash.com/data
2. Scroll down to the 'Unsplash Lite Dataset' section.
3. Click the 'Download' button.
4. Verify that you are redirected to the official Unsplash Datasets GitHub repository.

Workflows.title: Help Center Article Search and Navigation
Workflows.goal: Search for licensing information and navigate back using breadcrumbs.
Workflows.starting_hint:
1. Navigate to https://help.unsplash.com/en/
2. Type 'license' into the 'Search for articles...' input field and press Enter.
3. Click on the article titled 'Unsplash License'.
4. Verify the article content loads, then click the 'Help Center' breadcrumb to return to the home page.

Workflows.title: Blog Category Filtering and Pagination
Workflows.goal: Filter blog posts by category and load more content using pagination.
Workflows.starting_hint:
1. Navigate to https://unsplash.com/blog/
2. Click on the 'Product' category link in the sub-navigation bar.
3. Scroll to the bottom of the filtered list and click the 'Load more posts' button.
4. Verify that additional product-related articles are appended to the list.
